goal: Recover the authorized 2026-09-25 owner ruling from PR #3564 on a fresh main branch: route curated Master Data loads to a dedicated data session outside the orchestrator, while retaining all section 6.4 curation protections and migration-author lane rules.
prohibited_actions: Do not touch any migration or database object.
Do not weaken section 6.4 curation protections, including matched-row abstention and binding the session doing the typing.
Do not route curated Master Data to an application repository.
Do not change structural routing or the self-service additive lane boundary.
assumptions: Generation 1 in PR #3564 candidly disclosed publication after its implementation. This fresh branch re-applies the same authorized net change only after generation 2 is published; the original branch and ref remain available for audit.
Owner ruling 2026-09-25 (Albert Hazan, as recorded in issue #3563): curated Master Data loads do not need an orchestrator.
stop_conditions: Stop on any gate refusal rather than weakening the gate.
Stop if the change needs a file outside allowed_paths.
Stop if section 6.4 curation protections would be weakened.
